snippet.title: Once Human｜Now Live on Console
snippet.description:
🎮 Once Human is now on console. Welcome to the strange worlds!
Free to play on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with full cross-play across PC, Mobile, and Console.

Strange worlds are yours to explore. Build your life, find your way to survive, and make it your own.

🔗 Jump in today: https://www.oncehuman.game/console/

#OnceHuman #PS5 #XBOX #OnceHumanConsole
